traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Acid damage. Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6). Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot- wide Line. Failure: 49 (14d6) Acid damage. Success: Half damage. Adult Black Dragon

legendaryActions.name: Legendary Action Uses
legendaryActions.text: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature’s turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

legendaryActions.name: Cloud of Insects
legendaryActions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet. Failure: 22 (4d10) Poison damage, and the target has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration until the end of its next turn. Failure or Success: The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Frightful Presence
legendaryActions.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast

legendaryActions.name: Fear
legendaryActions.text: The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Pounce
legendaryActions.text: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.
